## Changes
- Whisper now runs on whisper.cpp with Metal, faster and lighter. After updating, download Whisper again in Settings → Local models (you'll get one notice). Pick a build: Full (1.6 GB), Balanced (870 MB) or Small (550 MB); the one for your Mac is preselected. - Whisper can now caption calls live, in English and Romanian, one line per phrase. It needs the small Voice detection model, which downloads with Whisper. - Settings → Transcription → Language is now a picker: Autodetect (English or Romanian), English, Romanian, English + Romanian, or Other. - Autodetect now means English or Romanian everywhere. Whistle has no Romanian, so it no longer takes Autodetect calls, and a call that keeps no audio won't start on Whistle. - When live captions can't run, the warning offers one fix: Use Whisper, Use Parakeet or Download Whisper. "Don't keep call audio" now names the engine that writes the transcript. - The Transcription engine and Live captions pickers list every online service, marked "needs API key" until its key is saved. - New in Settings → Local models: Download Again, to delete a model and download a fresh copy.

## Changes
- New in Settings → General: "Don't keep call audio". With it on, calls are transcribed live and only the transcript is saved; the audio is never written to disk. The live transcript becomes the call's transcript, and insights, exports and notifications work as usual. - If no live captions engine can run, a transcript-only call won't start, and Ahoy tells you what to change in Settings. If live transcription stops mid-call, the call ends and you're notified. - Transcript-only calls can't be transcribed again, played back or split by speaker, because there is no audio. Imported files lose their audio once they are transcribed.

## Changes
- Pressing Space on an action item's Edit button from the keyboard now puts the cursor in the editor, so you can type straight away. Before, focus moved on to Send to Reminders.
